race.comment: MY BOY SCOUT (5) went a lot better second up from a spell at Bathurst and showed this could well be his distance range. He will need some luck from the draw but seems to be a horse who is improving with racing now. SLEEK 'N' STYLE (8) went leading three weeks ago and it lifted her performance greatly. She held on to win and can do something similar here. SYMPHONITE (12) is a horse who likes to get back in her races but does find the line each time. All she will need is the pace on and in a big field that seems assured. PENCILLER (1) has to be better for that resuming run. Another 200m will help too.
